description: Influent flow and effluent from the treatment plant (summer season 2015) (archives) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. This set shows the data related to inflow and effluent from the treatment plant during the 2015 summer season. These data were subject to special treatments (simulation and estimation efforts) to offer more flexibility to the prototypes developed as part of the Aquahacking 2016 event. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Affluent, Aquahacking, Water, Effluent, St. Lawrence River. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, PDF, XLS. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
